prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image: edit target, a 2x2 walking sprite sheet.
Primary request: MARGIN/PADDING CORRECTION ONLY. Return the complete same 2x2 four-frame sheet, genuine transparent RGBA. Preserve every character pose and artwork exactly; proportionally shrink each entire character to 90% of its present size within its own quarter, and recenter inside its quarter. Do not shrink the sheet as one picture. Each frame must have at least 25px fully transparent breathing room on ALL sides of its own cell (each original cell is 627x627, sheet1254x1254). No hair, feet, ears, whiskers, clothing or accessories may cross x=627 or y=627 or touch any cell border. Uniform identical scale factor for all four poses. Keep original phase order A top-left, B top-right, C bottom-left, B bottom-right.
Invariants: pose angles, opposite leg ordering, limb anatomy, proportions, face, costume, lighting and style unchanged. B feet beneath body; A and C opposite leg lead. Do not regenerate a new walk pose or copy A legs into C. Preserve limb crossings. All feet continue to point right.
Remove every isolated stray pixel/speck not attached to the character. Clean native alpha, no checkerboard, no grid lines, no letters, no background, no shadows, no decoration. Chuming: long cyan/pink twin-tails and every blue-shoe tip must fit entirely within each quadrant. C near foreground leg slopes down-left, far leg right. A near leg leads down-right. Keep star outfit and empty tiny hands.
marginCorrection.visualInspection: A/C opposite leg lead and B passing pose preserved after padding correction. Hair/paw tips now fully within their own frame.
marginCorrection.note: Very low-alpha antialiasing/noise below32 is excluded by the shared reviewer bounds criterion; native generated alpha is preserved without filtering.

prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image: edit target, a 2x2 walking sprite sheet.
Primary request: MARGIN/PADDING CORRECTION ONLY. Return the complete same 2x2 four-frame sheet, genuine transparent RGBA. Preserve every character pose and artwork exactly; proportionally shrink each entire character to 90% of its present size within its own quarter, and recenter inside its quarter. Do not shrink the sheet as one picture. Each frame must have at least 25px fully transparent breathing room on ALL sides of its own cell (each original cell is 627x627, sheet1254x1254). No hair, feet, ears, whiskers, clothing or accessories may cross x=627 or y=627 or touch any cell border. Uniform identical scale factor for all four poses. Keep original phase order A top-left, B top-right, C bottom-left, B bottom-right.
Invariants: pose angles, opposite leg ordering, limb anatomy, proportions, face, costume, lighting and style unchanged. B feet beneath body; A and C opposite leg lead. Do not regenerate a new walk pose or copy A legs into C. Preserve limb crossings. All feet continue to point right.
Remove every isolated stray pixel/speck not attached to the character. Clean native alpha, no checkerboard, no grid lines, no letters, no background, no shadows, no decoration. Pantry-cat: protect all four paw tips, especially bottom-left cell's far forward front paw that currently reaches right cell boundary. Keep C front and hind legs in their exact opposite stride arrangement, not the A leg layout. Pink collar/paw badge unchanged.

Use case precise-object-edit. Padding adjustment only to complete the same 2x2 four-frame transparent RGBA sprite sheet. In BOTTOM-LEFT quadrant ONLY, move the ENTIRE cat and all its whiskers/tail/paws left by 30 pixels, preserving exact size, pose,shape and every detail. This is a whole-character reposition, NOT a leg change. Leave the other3frames unchanged. Its farthest forward paw must have at least30px transparent margin from center vertical boundary x=627; currently it has only11px. Keep canvas1254square, invisible2x2grid, no cropping or new framing. No scales changed. Preserve A/C opposite foreleg and hindleg lead, B under-body paws, identity,pink collar/paw badge. Remove stray detached pixels only. True alpha background, no scene,grid,text,shadow. Output fullfourframes not portrait.
marginCorrection.visualInspection: A/C opposite leg lead and B passing pose preserved after padding correction. Hair/paw tips now fully within their own frame.
marginCorrection.note: Very low-alpha antialiasing/noise below32 is excluded by the shared reviewer bounds criterion; native generated alpha is preserved without filtering.
